رَشْحَةٌ [as an inf. n. of un., A sweat, or a sweating: a meaning indicated, though not expressed, in the A. ―
-b2- Hence, app., (assumed tropical:) A dew, or fall of dew from the sky. ―
-b3- And hence, as being likened thereto, (tropical:) A gift]. You say, أَصَابَنِى بِرَشْحَةٍ مِنْ سَمَائِهِ (tropical:) [He gave me a gift from his store of bounty]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
